name: fojlerabbirabib/apiclient-drive-service
description: A slim, auto-synced, Drive-only subset of google/apiclient-services (unofficial, not affiliated with Google).

suggest.google/apiclient: ^2.15 — provides the Google\Client / Google\Service / Google\Model / Google\Collection base classes this package's generated classes extend. Declared as suggest (not require) so consumers pick the version; this package `provide`s google/apiclient-services and `conflict`s the real one, so google/apiclient installs cleanly without pulling the 200MB full catalog.
